"YCC" can stand for several different things depending on the context. A few common ones include:

🔹 **Young Conservatives Club** (often used in schools or political organizations)  
🔹 **Youth Climate Coalition** or similar environmental youth groups  
🔹 **Your Choice Clothing** (a brand or retail reference)  
🔹 In gaming/tech communities, it might be a clan tag, server acronym, or project shorthand
